newsitem.title: UK: GEEST SIGNS FOOD DEAL WITH ALBERT HEIJN.
newsitem.headline: GEEST SIGNS FOOD DEAL WITH ALBERT HEIJN.

text.p: Geest Plc said on Monday it has agreed with Albert Heijn, the subsidiary of Dutch supermarket group Royal Ahold , to manufacture a new chilled food range for Heijn in the UK and Belgium.
It said that it will buy the Belgian manufacturing company Vaco B.V. from Ahold for 4.9 million stg in cash.
Food group Geest said this was the first substantial partnership with a European retailer that it has entered into and Vaco would be the first Geest prepared foods facility outside the UK.
It said Albert Heijn had a 27 percent share of the Dutch grocery trade with 646 supermarkets and annualised sales of 4.0 billion stg in total.
By 1228 GMT, shares in Geest has climbed 7-1/2p to 255p.
